kept.because: p13 kept a rule whose list held .a::-webkit-scrollbar in mainUi, the EFB's document, and the toolbar's, and p14 didn't try it (measured on MSFS 2024, 2026-10-25, Dual Input, record/areas/architecture/log.md, "2026-10-25: Coherent GT drops `@layer`, oklch, `color-mix()`, and every `gap` but `grid-gap`, so Tailwind 4's output can't style a page there")
@charset names a file's encoding and becomes no rule in any engine's CSSOM, so p14 saw neither engine keep it, and the check passes it unmeasured

dropped.message: opacity as a percent is dropped by Coherent GT, which reads a number such as 0.5
dropped.because: p13 read opacity: 50% back as 1 in mainUi, the EFB's document, and the toolbar's (measured on MSFS 2024, 2026-10-25, Dual Input, record/areas/architecture/log.md, "2026-10-25: Coherent GT drops `@layer`, oklch, `color-mix()`, and every `gap` but `grid-gap`, so Tailwind 4's output can't style a page there")

ignored.message: column-gap parses in Coherent GT and then spaces nothing, in a grid or a flex row, where grid-column-gap spaces a grid
ignored.because: p13 laid out column-gap in a grid and in a flex row and found no space, while CSS.supports said yes, and grid-column-gap spaced the grid (measured on MSFS 2024, 2026-10-25, Dual Input, record/areas/architecture/log.md, "2026-10-25: Coherent GT drops `@layer`, oklch, `color-mix()`, and every `gap` but `grid-gap`, so Tailwind 4's output can't style a page there")

ignored.message: justify-content: end parses in Coherent GT and then packs at the start, where flex-end packs at the end
ignored.because: p14's layout case put a flex row's first box at 0px where Chromium put it at 80px (measured on MSFS 2024, 2026-10-25, Dual Input, record/areas/architecture/log.md, "2026-10-25: Coherent GT keeps 304 of the 554 CSS properties Chromium 152 keeps, and lays out flexbox and grid as Chromium does but for `gap`, `justify-content: end`, and subgrid")
